rina: Idea Credit Velocity Mini 10-seat pilot to test fast-expiry credits (48h) vs standard 7-day credits + two onboarding nudges (tooltip vs walkthrough). Metric: day-2 activation and time-to-first-success. Thoughts? :rocket:

maya: Love it. Keep n=210 for power, randomize by cookie, split 105/105. Suggest 50 credits each.

jamie: Nudge definitions: Tooltip = micro tips next to UI; Walkthrough = 3-step interactive flow. Activation = any generation >10 tokens marked useful.

nate: Creative: short reel + 1-panel hero. CTA variations: "Try Starter" / "Join Live Help". Assets by Tue.

leah: Office hours Wed/Thu. Reminder emails: confirm, 24h nudge, replay + credit-expires reminder.

aj: Routing: utm=credit_velocity. If >3 requests in 24h mark 'hot' and invite to office hours. I'll add tracking.

samir: Infra: pre-warm 20m before sessions, cap GPUs=14, fallback to quantized model at 80% util, enable prefix caching for starter prompts.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Autoscale set project/credit-velocity (min=1,max=14). Alert p95 latency > 600ms -> page.

rina: Action items: @aj tags + analytics, @samir infra pre-warm + fallback, @leah emails + reg flow, @nate creative. Quick sync Mon 9:00 to confirm. Thanks! :tada:
